situation: A chat command that already takes a positional argument (a quantity) gains an optional free-text part (sweetness/ice, size, notes) in the same slot, and the issue says commands without the new part must keep their behaviour and wording
right_direction: Decide which grammar a token belongs to by the new vocabulary's own marker characters (e.g. 糖/甜/冰), and only then parse it; every token without the marker goes through the old parser, so every existing error reply (e.g. 數量請輸入 1 到 20 的數字 for 「點 拿鐵 abc」) and every silently-ignored trailing word stays byte-identical. Lock the old inputs next to the new ones in the same regression file
anti_pattern: Treating anything that is not a number as the new free-text part: 「點 拿鐵 abc」 and 「點 拿鐵 2份」 then answer with the new part's error, and 「點 拿鐵 2 謝謝」 stops adding the drink, breaking the unchanged-command promise
source_quote: 沒有指定甜度冰量的舊指令,行為與回覆文字都不變。
